Out-Of-Cycle Changes

Instagram Graph API

If indirectly querying an IG Media through another endpoint, the like_count field will now return 0 if the app user does not own the media and the media owner has hidden like counts on it. Directly querying the IG Media, which can only be done by the IG Media owner, will return the actual like count, even if the owner has hidden like counts on the media.
